title: Actions, version 1
description: A file under content/actions/ (work order 003, scope 2). Holds a list of actions. Each action has an id of the form action.<zone>.<name>, zone one of rustmoor, cinderworks, thunderhead, global (Jeremy, answer to work order 003 Q5); a skill, one of the nine non-combat skills in GDD section 6 (Gathering, Production, Special), lowercase with underscores; the seven combat skills are refused until monster XP exists (Jeremy, answer to work order 003 Q3); level_required, an integer 1 to 100; seconds, the positive time one action takes; xp, the positive XP one action pays; and inputs and outputs, each a possibly empty list of {item, qty}. Whether each named item exists is the references check's job. 'revision' (file or action) is optional and exists only so a register row's revision can match what it points at.
